latest.title: Prehospital whole blood no better than components
latest.finding: 30-day mortality 25.9% with whole blood vs 20.5% with blood components (adjusted OR 1.24, 95% CI 0.87–1.76; P=0.24). No difference by whole blood storage age (15–21 days vs 1–14 days: adjusted OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.74–1.32).
